# openrouter_organization_settings (Resource)

Settings of the organization the management key belongs to. The settings always exist, so creating this resource writes the declared values and destroying it only removes them from state; the last applied values stay in effect. Declare at most one `openrouter_organization_settings` per organization. There is nothing to import: declaring the resource adopts the settings by applying the declared values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openrouter_organization_settings" "my_organizationsettings" {
  is_filtered_model_catalog_enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `is_filtered_model_catalog_enabled` (Boolean) When true, `GET /api/v1/models` called with one of the organization's API keys returns only the models that key can use (the `/api/v1/models/user` catalog), and the signed-in dashboard shows the same list. Anonymous requests always receive the public catalog.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the organization the settings belong to
